=== define-macro-args
--- main
!define SEND(a,b) a -> b
SEND(Alice,Bob)
=== define-simple-value
--- main
!define FOO bar
A : FOO
A : $FOO
=== define-simple-in-text
--- main
!define COLOR red
!define SIZE 12
A : COLOR SIZE COLORS XCOLOR
=== define-no-value
--- main
!define EMPTY
A : [EMPTY]
=== define-macro-quoted-args
--- main
!define MSG(a,b) a says b
MSG("Alice", "hello, world")
MSG('Bob', 'it, is')
=== define-macro-nested-parens
--- main
!define WRAP(x) [x]
WRAP(f(1,2))
WRAP((a,b))
=== define-macro-zero-args
--- main
!define NOARG() nothing here
A : NOARG()
=== define-macro-default-arg
--- main
!define GREET(name, greeting="hello") greeting name
GREET(Bob)
GREET(Bob, hi)
=== define-macro-in-macro
--- main
!define INNER(x) <x>
!define OUTER(y) INNER(y)!
A : OUTER(z)
=== define-macro-uses-variable
--- main
!$v = "VAL"
!define SHOW(x) x=$v
SHOW(a)
=== define-macro-wrong-arity
--- main
!define TWO(a,b) a+b
TWO(1)
TWO(1,2,3)
=== define-macro-hash
--- main
!define CAT(a,b) a##b
A : CAT(foo,bar)
=== define-redefine
--- main
!define X 1
!define X 2
A : X
=== define-undef
--- main
!define X 1
!undef X
A : X
=== define-undef-macro
--- main
!define M(a) <a>
!undef M
A : M(1)
=== definelong-basic
--- main
!definelong BLOCK(a, b)
a -> b : one
b -> a : two
!enddefinelong
BLOCK(Alice, Bob)
=== definelong-single-line
--- main
!definelong ONE(a)
a -> a
!enddefinelong
A : ONE(x)
ONE(y)
=== definelong-no-parens
--- main
!definelong NOP
X -> Y
Y -> X
!enddefinelong
NOP()
=== definelong-prefix-text
--- main
!definelong TWO(a)
first a
second a
!enddefinelong
prefix TWO(x) suffix
=== definelong-unclosed
--- main
!definelong OPEN(a)
a -> a
=== define-ifdef
--- main
!define DEBUG
!ifdef DEBUG
A : debug on
!endif
!ifndef DEBUG
A : debug off
!endif
=== define-ifdef-expression
--- main
!define A1
!define B1
!ifdef A1 && B1
X : both
!endif
!ifdef A1 || C1
X : either
!endif
!ifdef !C1
X : not c
!endif
!ifdef (A1 && !C1) || C1
X : complex
!endif
=== define-ifdef-function
--- main
!function $f()
!return 1
!endfunction
!ifdef $f
X : f exists
!endif
=== define-ifdef-bad
--- main
!ifdef (
X : y
!endif
=== define-ifdef-trailing
--- main
!define A1
!ifdef A1 B1
X : y
!endif
=== define-unquoted-function-call
--- main
!unquoted function $u($a)
!return "<" + $a + ">"
!endfunction
A : $u(hello world)
A : $u("quoted")
A : $u(x, y)
=== define-legacy-uppercase
--- main
!DEFINE FOO bar
A : FOO
=== define-uses-defined
--- main
!define A1 one
!define B1 A1 two
A : B1
=== define-paren-not-call
--- main
!define F(x) <x>
A : F (1)
A : xF(1)
A : _F(1)
=== define-emoji
--- main
!define 😀X(a) smile a
A : 😀X(1)
